title: 'Building Bridges, Creating Customers' marketing pack in white with teal-purple flat illustrations

whatItMeans: Clean and professional; consistent gradient bars and figure illustrations make a marketing pitch feel approachable rather than corporate-stiff.

Use a gradient bar as a consistent footer or divider element.
